title: JAX-Nano: A GPU-Accelerated Differentiable Phonon Boltzmann Transport Solver for Nanoscale Heat Transfer
abstract: arXiv:2611.28926v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: As semiconductor device dimensions approach phonon mean free paths, heat transport enters ballistic and quasi-ballistic regimes where Fourier's law becomes inadequate. The phonon Boltzmann transport equation (BTE) describes these nonequilibrium effects but presents significant computational challenges. This work introduces JAX-Nano, a GPU-accelerated, end-to-end differentiable phonon BTE solver for nanoscale heat transport. The solver integrates steady-state and transient BTE formulations within a unified finite-volume framework, supporting structured and unstructured meshes, mode-resolved transport, phonon scattering, volumetric heat generation, and multiple boundary conditions. Automatic differentiation enables gradient computation with respect to transport properties, boundary conditions, heat-generation rates, and geometric parameters without separately derived adjoint equations. Numerical predictions are validated against analytic

translated_title: JAX-Nano：一种用于纳米尺度热传输的GPU加速可微分声子玻尔兹曼输运求解器
translated_abstract: 随着半导体器件尺寸接近声子平均自由程，热传输进入弹道和准弹道区间，此时傅里叶定律不再适用。声子玻尔兹曼输运方程（BTE）能够描述这些非平衡效应，但带来了巨大的计算挑战。本工作提出了JAX-Nano，一种用于纳米尺度热传输的GPU加速、端到端可微分的声子BTE求解器。该求解器在统一的有限体积框架内集成了稳态和瞬态BTE公式，支持结构化和非结构化网格、模式分辨输运、声子散射、体积热生成以及多种边界条件。自动微分使其能够直接计算输运性质、边界条件、热生成率和几何参数相关的梯度，而无需单独推导伴随方程。数值预测结果与分析解进行了验证。
tldr: 本文提出JAX-Nano，一种GPU加速、端到端可微分的声子玻尔兹曼输运方程求解器，能在统一有限体积框架下模拟纳米尺度稳态与瞬态热传输，并借助自动微分直接计算输运性质、边界条件、热生成率和几何参数的梯度，无需手动推导伴随方程。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces JAX-Nano, a GPU-accelerated, end-to-end differentiable phonon BTE solver that simulates steady-state and transient nanoscale heat transport within a unified finite-volume framework and leverages automatic differentiation to compute gradients with respect to transport properties, boundary conditions, heat-generation rates, and geometric parameters without separately derived adjoint equations.
